# Tehilim v2 — Complete Redesign

This branch (`claude/tehilim-v2-clean`) is a **major refactor replacing the old WordPress plugin/theme stack with a new, purpose-built WordPress theme** built directly from the design-reference handoff.

## What's Changing

- **Old stack** (to be deleted):
  - `psalms-unite-theme/` (v1.14.0) — old Lovable-inspired theme
  - `tehillim-campaign-manager/` (v3.25.0) — legacy plugin with complex modules

- **New stack** (to be built):
  - `tehilim-theme/` — new classic WordPress theme, 1:1 from design-reference HTML
  - Minimal plugin or CPT infrastructure only (if needed for REST/data)

## Architecture

### Custom Post Types (CPT)
- `campaign` — campaign with metadata (dedication, goal_books, occasion taxonomy)
- `ambassador` — ambassador profiles (per campaign, with goal_chapters, avatar_color)

### Data Layer
- `wp_tehilim_recitations` — atomic recording of completed chapters (no CPT needed)
- Tehilim text (150 chapters, niqud) — sourced from Sefaria or static JSON

### Frontend (PHP Templates)
- `index.php` — homepage hero, campaigns section, FAQ, testimonials, CTA
- `archive-campaign.php` — all campaigns grid + occasion filtering
- `single-campaign.php` — campaign page with reader, progress, ambassadors, activity feed
- `template-ambassador.php` — public referral link (ambassador-specific)
- `template-dashboard.php` — private ambassador dashboard
- `page-create.php` — campaign creation form
- Assets: `header.php`, `footer.php`, RTL support, Asimon font

### Dynamic Features
- Chapter reader with "I said this" (AJAX/REST) → Turnstile protected
- Live progress updates (polls or WebSocket)
- Campaign creation + ambassador signup workflow
- WhatsApp/link sharing

## Multi-Digital Guidelines

- ✅ Maintain Hebrew `dir="rtl"` throughout
- ✅ Respect Asimon font licensing (provided in handoff)
- ✅ Maintain contrast WCAG AA+
- ✅ No emojis; SVG icons only
- ✅ Design tokens match handoff exactly (colors, spacing, radius, shadows)
- ✅ Responsive: 375px / 768px / 1024px / 1440px
- ✅ Animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`

## Git Strategy

1. Delete old theme and plugin from this branch
2. Build new theme structure and templates
3. Incremental commits per feature (header → footer → home → campaigns → reader, etc.)
4. Single squash-merge PR to main when QA-green

## QA Gate
- PHPCS (WordPress standard)
- PHP -l (parse check)
- Contrast audit (WAVE / axe)
- Responsive test (DevTools + Playwright if available)
- RTL rendering check
